successCriteria.description: `src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts` exists and exports the `LeaveRequest` interface with all 17 canonical fields: `id` (string), `employeeId` (string), `leavePolicyId` (string), `startDate` (Date), `endDate` (Date), `reason` (string | undefined), `status` (LeaveRequestStatus), `approvedBy` (string | null), `approvedAt` (Date | null), `rejectedBy` (string | null), `rejectedAt` (Date | null), `rejectionReason` (string | null), `cancelledBy` (string | null), `cancelledAt` (Date | null), `cancellationReason` (string | null), `createdAt` (Date), `updatedAt` (Date).

`src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts` exports `CreateLeaveRequestDto` with fields: `employeeId` (string, required), `leavePolicyId` (string, required), `startDate` (Date, required), `endDate` (Date, required), `reason` (string, optional).

`src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts` exports `UpdateLeaveRequestDto` as a partial of status-relevant fields only: `status`, `approvedBy`, `approvedAt`, `rejectedBy`, `rejectedAt`, `rejectionReason`, `cancelledBy`, `cancelledAt`, `cancellationReason` — all optional.

`src/modules/leave/leave.repository.ts` exists and exports `ILeaveRequestRepository` interface with all 8 methods: `findById`, `findByEmployee`, `findByStatus`, `findByDateRange`, `query`, `create`, `update`, `delete` — each with the exact signatures from PLAN.md Phase 6.

`src/modules/leave/leave.service.interface.ts` exists and exports `ILeaveService` interface with all 8 methods: `create`, `submit`, `approve`, `reject`, `cancel`, `getById`, `getByEmployee`, `query` — each with the exact signatures from PLAN.md Phase 6.
All three files compile without errors under strict TypeScript (`tsc --noEmit` passes) and contain zero runtime logic — only type/interface declarations and imports.

constraints: No `any` type anywhere — use `unknown` with type guards if a dynamic type is needed (per HARNESS.json constraint `no-any`).
Strict TypeScript: no implicit any, strict null checks enabled. All files must pass `tsc --noEmit`.
ES module exports only — use `export interface` / `export type`, not `module.exports` or `export default`.
No runtime logic in these files — no function bodies, no class implementations, no side effects. Only type/interface declarations and imports.
outOfScope: `src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts` — service implementation (owned by sibling sub-phase "Phase 6b: Leave module — service, routes & barrel export").
`src/modules/leave/index.ts` — barrel export (owned by sibling sub-phase "Phase 6b: Leave module — service, routes & barrel export").

entityInvariants.invariant: The `status` field must be one of the `LeaveRequestStatus` enum values. The valid lifecycle transitions are: DRAFT → SUBMITTED; SUBMITTED → APPROVED; SUBMITTED → REJECTED; DRAFT, SUBMITTED, or APPROVED → CANCELLED. No other transitions are valid.

The actor-timestamp pairs (`approvedBy`/`approvedAt`, `rejectedBy`/`rejectedAt`, `cancelledBy`/`cancelledAt`) are mutually exclusive: at most one pair is non-null at any time, corresponding to the terminal state. When `status` is APPROVED, only `approvedBy`/`approvedAt` are non-null; when REJECTED, only `rejectedBy`/`rejectedAt`/`rejectionReason`; when CANCELLED, only `cancelledBy`/`cancelledAt`/`cancellationReason`; otherwise all are null.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns the created LeaveRequest with server-assigned `id`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`. Input is `Omit<LeaveRequest, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>`.
Returns the updated LeaveRequest or null if not found. Accepts `Partial<LeaveRequest>` — only the fields present are changed.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: `LeaveRequest.status` must use the `LeaveRequestStatus` enum imported from `src/shared/types/index.ts` — the same enum used by all other modules for leave status.

The import path for `LeaveRequestStatus` from within `src/modules/leave/` must be `../../shared/types/index` — matching the relative-path convention used by sibling modules (e.g., `policy.model.ts` imports `LeaveType` from `../../shared/types/index`).

`ILeaveRequestRepository` method signatures must follow the same patterns as `ILeavePolicyRepository` and `IBalanceRepository`: `findById` returns `Promise<T | null>`, `create` accepts `Omit<T, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>` and returns `Promise<T>`, `update` accepts `(id: string, data: Partial<T>)` and returns `Promise<T | null>`, `delete` accepts `(id: string)` and returns `Promise<boolean>`.
